title: Investigating the Effect of Update Strengths for Atomic-Resolution Low-Dose Imaging in Iterative Ptychography
content: The widespread adoption of aberration correction [1] has enabled atomic imaging of crystalline materials. However, numerous of these are susceptible to beam damage [2], which presents challenges for high-resolution. Conventional transmission electron microscopy (CTEM) is widely utilized for this purpose, but methods based on scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), such as ptychography, have demonstrated promising results for low dose imaging [3, 4].
